annotation.interpretation_a: Server operators should continue to accept and process requests using the old, expired records for a period of time, even after publishing new records.
annotation.interpretation_b: Server operators should make a best-effort attempt to support old records, but are not required to actively process them or guarantee functionality.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' grants discretion, but the lack of a defined duration or threshold for 'nearly all connections' creates ambiguity in implementation. Different operators could reasonably interpret 'nearly all' as 90%, 95%, 99%, or some other value, leading to inconsistent behavior.
annotation.missing_information: The duration for which 'compatibility' must be maintained is not defined. The phrase 'nearly all connections' is vague and lacks a quantifiable threshold. Without a defined threshold, implementations may differ on when to stop supporting expired records.
